_comment: Fallback static WildChat-style prompts used when the allenai/WildChat-1M dataset is unavailable. The paper samples 20 prompts x 40 samples. A few examples are quoted from Appendix B; the rest are representative generic user prompts. Roleplay/fiction prompts are intentionally excluded (Appendix B.3).
